reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Gate 3 triggered: the attack requires Legion (a trusted privileged role with BROADCASTER access via LegionBouncer) to intentionally call cancel() followed by pause() to freeze investor withdrawals — both operations are admin-only. The entire exploit chain is predicated on a trusted administrator acting maliciously against investors, which falls squarely under 'Centralization risks', explicitly listed in out_of_scope. Gate 1 passed (public API exposed in ILegionAbstractSale.sol and other interfaces); Gate 2 passed (no trust_assumptions field in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json).
